verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents OpenTelemetry-based tracing, so traces can be sent to it from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application instead of only through its own SDKs. That covers the ingest half of the story, but the evidence is a single doc line, and nothing shows traces being exported or received back out over OTLP. The trace export that is documented runs through the UI or API, not OTLP. Missing for 10: evidence of OTLP export or outbound OTel traces, details on OTLP endpoint and protocol support, and independent hands-on corroboration of OTel ingestion.
